rev.t:
Love the place!!
Have been visiting Xero Degrees quite often ever since my office shifted next to them. …
Located in the heart of buzzing Koramangala.The ambience is really pleasant - clean, cozy, and relaxing with a very comfortable vibe, stylish setup that makes the place feel inviting. …

Xero Degrees is a good spot if you’re in the mood for desserts, mocktais, and pizza, all under one roof. The place has a lively vibe, especially in the evenings, and works well for catching up with friends or just grabbing a quick bite. …
